I learned farming from my father, and I watch what my neighbors do on their plots. This land is not mine, so I will not put manure here or buy fertilizer — I keep those for my own fields. I will plant the same seed I saved from last season, and my family will pull the weeds by hand. We have no money for chemicals or hired workers, so we wait for the rains and do the work ourselves.
